entries.source: Or. Wittingau. (den s. Trojice). MarešMareš., RI XI,2 n. 9484
entries.german: Sigmund befiehlt Ulrich v. Rosenberg, die dem Johann d. jüng. v. Sobětic entzogene Hälfte des Gutes Moldautein diesem Anhänger des Kaisers zurückzustellen. De mandato d. i. Caspar Slick ─ o. R
entries.english: Sigmund orders Ulrich von Rosenberg to restore to Johann von Sobětice the Younger the half of the estate at Moldautein that had been taken from him, since he is a supporter of the Emperor. By mandate of the imperial majesty, Caspar Slick. No register entry.
